dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Might <color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> be interested in some sugar sculptures...?)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I'll have one sugar sculpture, Hunajatta.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Lady Nefer, what an unexpected surprise. What brings you here today?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I find getting out and taking a walk every now and then is good for both body and mind.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Besides, having something sweet helps my thought process.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Give me a minute, I'll rustle you one up right away!

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Many thanks. And while I'm here, take this money. The next time Jahoda comes by...

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Make her an extra-large one? Make it even sweeter?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: ...Give the money to her.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: And tell her, "Nefer's paying double, so once you're done lazing around, head back. And grab a sugar sculpture for the boss while you're at it."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Might <color=#FFCC33FF>Linnea</color> be interested in some sugar sculptures...?)

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Oh, hello, Miss Linnea! Here to buy more sugar sculptures for Lumi?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: I sure am! Lumi loves your sugar sculptures so much, she can't even bring herself to eat them — she just licks them once and then gives them to me for safekeeping.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: But, since they're made of sugar... they end up melting anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: So, if I could trouble you, Miss Hunajatta, can you make me another one?

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Of course! Just give me a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: (Lumi's so adorable — I just want to pet her! But that feels like it would be a bit rude. Oh well...)

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Here you go, Miss Linnea. One sugar sculpture.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Thank you! Lumi, it's ready, do you want it n— Oh, she's fallen asleep. I'll give it to her later.

talks.objective: Distribute sugar sculpture box - General dialogue $HIDDEN

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: One sugar sculpture, please.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Here you go. Eat it quick once you open it, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Perhaps <color=#FFCC33FF>Lauma</color>'s interested in sugar sculptures...?)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Could you make me a few, please, Miss Hunajatta?

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: No problem, Miss Lauma. Did the kids like the batch you brought back last time?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hehe, that they did. In fact, some of them could only be convinced to ruin their beautiful treats once they had almost melted away.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: I see... You know what? I'll bring my tools and go to you all next time. You know, set up a live station for the kids.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Ah, that would be lovely. The children will be so happy.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Oh, and uh, guess we're getting off topic, huh? I'll go make your sugar sculptures. Once they're done, I'll have someone deliver it to the Scions.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: But before that... Hehe, I have a good idea~

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: One moment, Miss Lauma. I'll whip something special up for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Might <color=#FFCC33FF>Flins</color> have an interest in sugar sculptures...?)

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Miss Hunajatta. If I might impose, would you make me a sugar sculpture?

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Oh, sure. You're... Flins, the Ratnik, am I right? I think I've seen you in our store before.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Indeed you have. I do sometimes swing by to purchase supplies. It is an honor and a privilege to be remembered so.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: As for today, I just happened to be passing through when I witnessed your sugar-shaping mastery.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: And after much consideration, I decided that I must have you sculpt me a serving.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Oh, please, no need to be so polite. You're embarrassing me here~

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Just hold on a moment, one serving coming right up.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Hmm. Perhaps we should do something special for our good Ratnik...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Would <color=#FFCC33FF>Aino</color> be interested in some sugar sculptures...?)

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hiya Boss! One sugar sculpture, please!

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Oh, Miss Aino! It's been a while~

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hehe. Rolled into town to help fix some stuff. Thought I'd pop by and snag some candy!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Also, Ineffa isn't around, so... make me a few extras, would ya? And make 'em extra sweet!

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Well, sure... but you gotta brush your teeth once you're done eating, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Yeah, yeah, I know, I know. I always brush my teeth after eating candy! My teeth are super dee duper great!

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Haha... Hold on a moment, then...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Might <color=#FFCC33FF>Ineffa</color> be interested in some sugar sculptures...?)

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Excuse me. Could I trouble you to make me one sugar sculpture?

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Sure. For Miss Aino, I presume?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Negative. Aino requested that I come and buy myself a beautiful sugar sculpture.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: According to her, this is part of my "social activity" training, which will make shopping more convenient in future.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: I see~

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Though I do not understand. I do not require this much sugar intake.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I suspect that Aino may wind up eating this sculpture in secret.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Miss Hunajatta, could you construct a sugar sculpture with smaller dimensions?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Aino loves candy, but I believe she should eat somewhat less.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I've got this... Now, let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Would <color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> be interested in some sugar sculptures...?)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: An extra-large one, please, boss.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: It's not your first time here, Jahoda. You know the size of our sugar sculptures is fixed.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Come on, everything's turning up roses today! Hurry it up, just a little bigger than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Turning up roses? Your commission went well then, I suppose?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hehehe, of course. Just a simple escort mission. Easy peasy, done and dusted.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Not a single hair harmed on the client's head, not a single scratch found on the cargo.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Okay, I'm done talking. Speed it along, let's get that sugar sculpture on the go, I'll take it to go.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: No problem. Give me a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Claim a Moon-Prayer Night Sugar Sculpture)

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Here's your Sugar Sculpture. Happy Moon-Prayer Night!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Would <color=#FFCC33FF>Columbina</color> be interested in some sugar sculptures...?)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Sugar sculpture... I think I've tried it before. Could you make one for me?

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: No problem! Just wait a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: (Hmm... Have I seen this girl somewhere in town before...?)

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: (Wow! She looks so full of anticipation... Ah, think, think! What style would suit her best?)

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: (Go with your instinct... follow your gut... okay, okay! I've got this!)

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Umm... I'm done. Take a look — do you like it?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: It looks great. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Hehe, I'm glad you like it.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: (Yes, my instinct was right — this light, airy style suits such a light, airy kid!)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Mmm, it's really tasty too...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Could you make two more? I want to take them back for the kuuhenki to try as well.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: For... the kuuhenki too? Well, I could, but I don't have enough ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Then I'll come back tomorrow and bring them with me.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: No problem... See you then...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Would <color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> be interested in some sugar sculptures...?)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Well, since I'm already here... Hello, one sugar sculpture, please!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Oh! Could you make it a bit smaller? I'm worried something might come up and I won't be able to finish it in one go...

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: No problem at all! Don't worry — even the small ones taste just as good.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Still, you Lightkeepers really do have your hands full... even a sugar sculpture might go unfinished.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Um... Ahaha... Well, it's not just the duties. Sometimes it's because I run into someone who needs help.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: You know how it is — half-eaten sugar sculptures are hard to keep. All I can really do is wrap it up in cloth and tuck it into my pocket...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: But by the time I'm done helping and take it back out, the whole thing's melted away...

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: I see... Let me think. A small sugar sculpture... hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Got it! I can make a small sculpture with multiple flavors!

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Layer this flavor on the bottom... then this one on top...

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: All right! Here you go, a mini, multi-flavor sugar sculpture! Does this suit your needs, dear customer?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Ah, it's perfect! Thank you, Ms. Hunajatta!

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Oh, don't mention it. I may not be able to help you Ratniki with your work... but if you ever want sugar sculptures, I can make as many as you like!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: That's our job. You're too kind, Ms. Hunajatta... I'll take my leave now, there's still work waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Hunajatta
dialogues.text: Okay, take care! And next time you want a sugar sculpture, just come straight over!
